Conversely, if CD247 is found to have a significant, direct role in erythrocyte membrane stability, it would strengthen the link but suggest a different convergence point. _(variant: High frequency (> 1%) of pathogenic loss-of-function variants in ICAM4 in the general population (gnomAD).)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of membrane protein integrity in both immune function and blood group determination could reveal novel therapeutic targets for immunodeficiencies or strategies to mitigate transfusion complications associated with rare blood groups.
